DIAGNOSIS READY: No significant finding.

I have reviewed your symptoms and the history of consuming ice cream three days ago. While the ice cream is likely incidental, your presentation of fever, headache, anorexia, and malaise at 30 weeks gestation is concerning for a viral infection like chickenpox (varicella) or listeriosis. Given the potential severity of these conditions during pregnancy, I need to confirm if you have any active rash or blistering lesions on your skin or mucous membranes.
